key_insight: F3-AGI v4.0 combines energy-gated learning, complexity-guided program synthesis, and active exploration to improve sample-efficient abstract reasoning on CPUs.
engineering_relevance: Its update gating and compact symbolic search may inform resource-constrained engineering AI, but the abstract reports no solid-mechanics or constitutive-modeling validation.
method: Gate plasticity using mistakes and virtual ATP, with Fisher-EMA preconditioning.
Search complexity-guided programs with residual patch synthesis and early rejection.
Guide exploration with 512D random projections, Expected Free Energy, and dead-signature pruning.
evidence_signal: Offline CPU evaluation with zero LLM calls solved 57/400 ARC-AGI-1 tasks (14.25% pass@2) at 1.62 s/task mean latency, including 38/350 strictly uninspected hold-out tasks.
watch_item: Calibration performance (38.00%) exceeds hold-out performance (10.86%), warranting caution about generalization beyond inspected tasks.
paper_title: F3-AGI v4.0: Bioenergetically-Gated Active Inference, Metaplastic Preconditioning, and Residual Program Synthesis for Sample-Efficient Abstract Reasoning
